description: This file defines the 'EachPromise' class in the GuzzleHttpomise namespace, implementing a promise that manages multiple promises with configurable concurrency and callback functions for fulfillment and rejection. It is part of a promise-handling library used to process multiple asynchronous operations.

classes.name: EachPromise
classes.description: A class to handle iteration over many promises, with support for concurrency control and callback execution on fulfilled or rejected promises.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an EachPromise instance with an iterable of promises/values and configuration options including concurrency limits and callback functions.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Returns the main promise that resolves when all managed promises are settled.

methods.name: createPromise
methods.description: Internal method to create and initialize the aggregate promise and set up the promise chain.

methods.name: refillPending
methods.description: Adds pending promises up to the concurrency limit and manages iterator advancement.

methods.name: addPending
methods.description: Converts the current iterator item into a promise, adds it to the pending list, and attaches fulfillment and rejection handlers.

methods.name: advanceIterator
methods.description: Moves the iterator forward, with locking to prevent reentrancy issues.

methods.name: step
methods.description: Handles the completion of a pending promise and triggers the addition of new promises if applicable.

methods.name: checkIfFinished
methods.description: Checks whether all promises are settled and resolves the aggregate promise if finished.
